Name: All Weather Drill
Description: Makes aquifer drills produce water during all weather conditions. Uses separate flow settings for Temperate, Drought, Badtide, and unknown Moddable Weathers conditions. Rain, Refreshing and Monsoon use Temperate scaling; Badtide and Drought take precedence whether they are base weather or modifiers. The live Moddable Weathers stage is queried when drill strength is calculated, so loading a save in the middle of an event does not reset flow to temperate.
